This clove is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in central Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

Siran can restore an organ or body part that has suffered severe damage. However, it temporarily weakens the skin and may provoke serious reactions to sunlight. Its Addiction Factor is exceptionally high: repeated use of such a potent remedy has grave consequences.
